entry_policy: Start from the canonical local graph at skills-library/skills.tmcp. Intent-driven traversal may cross registered namespaces only as overlays when they add behavior-changing task, module, branch, or portability guidance. Prefer the smallest behavior-changing packet; do not treat namespace boundaries as access limits.

portable_dev_process.description: Portable development-process overlay that can be vendored into non-AIOS repositories while remaining traversable from the canonical local TMCP graph. It is not the default local skill graph.

cross_namespace_edges.when: frontend generation or UI implementation needs visual polish
active project is Tenure or user explicitly requests Tenure-specific polish
active project is BidCamp or user explicitly requests BidCamp-specific polish
active project is Framework Labs or user explicitly requests Framework Labs-specific design
